title: An inverse limit of quasi-compact spaces is quasi-compact
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the inverse limit of an inverse system of quasi-compact spaces is quasi-compact (author lemma at source lines 2691-2697, label lemma-inverse-limit-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 2699-2715) writes the limit as an intersection of closed subsets of the product cut out by the graphs of the transition maps, notes that the intersection is closed and applies quasi-compactness of the product (proof lines 2699-2714). The description of the limit as a closed subset is the substance. H3.
